title: Directed 4.947N liminf on a fixed norm-one language

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. experiments.purpose: At the initial input verify the line-plus-repair cost, above-half start and all depth-fifteen bank rows by independent regeneration from all plus. In the fresh terminal follow-up read the identical immutable bank and compute nine further directed layers, the below-half terminal, and the literal site and root controls. The two outputs jointly check the complete directed claim at T=-13/50.
